msg: Hi. We want to complete our PADI open water: we have referrals and e-learning certificates. We would also like a refresher first. How does the 2 day open water referral course cost plus a mini course the day before. 2 persons. Thanks
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. So happy to have you here! I'd love to help you put your plan together. 🌊

That sounds like a great plan! Since you’ve completed the theory and pool sessions, the *Open Water Referral Course* is the right option to finish your certification. One important note: the refresher is for already-certified divers, and it does *not* count toward the referral course. If you haven’t dived in over two years, a refresher is normally required before diving.

The refresher is a pool session plus one ocean dive, with a same-day return to Cartagena. The referral course includes four certification dives over two days, but requires an overnight stay on the islands; accommodation isn’t included.

For two people, please select two participants for each activity in the booking flow—the exact total will be shown there. For the Referral Course, see course details: https://divingplanet.org/curso-padi-cartagena/referido/; I don’t have its booking link available here.

The referred course requires a PADI referral form signed by your original instructor; it is the “Open Water Referral Course,” not a regular dive trip.

To give you the exact price I need to know where you're starting from: would you leave *from Cartagena* or are you already *on the Rosario Islands*? Plans and prices change depending on the departure point. 🌊

msg: Ok. Thanks. We will work out the best days. Do you recommend any hotels on the island convenient for the diving?
reply:
Yes! For the most convenient access, I’d recommend *Hotel San Pedro de Majagua* or *Hotel Cocoliso* on Isla Grande—both are our dive bases, and pick-up is direct.

If you’re staying on the islands, pick-up and return are at your hotel if it has maritime access.

Other nearby hotels with maritime access include *Rosario de Mar, Secreto, Ubuntu, Mulata, Eco Hotel Las Palmeras, and Pao Pao*. Pick-up arrangements can vary by hotel, and accommodation is booked directly with the hotel. Would you like to stay at one of our base hotels or compare the other options?

msg: Great. We will book diving with you on the website and will book our hotel on the island . Hope you are operating on Easter Sunday? We want to dive on April 5 and 6. How do we book/pay for the $50 refresher course?
reply:
Yes! We operate every day of the year except December 25 and January 1, so Easter Sunday is no problem — and April 5 and 6 are great days to dive. 🌊

One thing to clarify on the refresher: it isn't $50. The refresher is booked as the *Dive Mini Course*, and the price depends on where you start from:

- *From Cartagena:* 183 USD / 655.000 COP online (204 USD / 727.000 COP regular) — includes boat Cartagena–Islands–Cartagena and lunch.
- *Already on the Rosario Islands:* 134 USD / 475.000 COP online (149 USD / 528.000 COP regular) — hotel pick-up if your hotel has boat access, lunch not included.

Since you're planning to stay on the island, the "already on the islands" option is usually the one that fits — but it depends on whether your hotel has boat access.

*How to book and pay:* you book directly on our website through the activity's link, and you pay there online (international clients pay 100% by card on the website). Here's the refresher link:

👉 https://book.divingplanet.org/book/dive-mini-course-already-on-island/20?language=en (already on the islands)

If you're leaving from Cartagena instead:
👉 https://book.divingplanet.org/book/minicurso-de-buceo/2?language=en

In the link you pick the date and the number of people (2), and the 10% online discount is already applied. Just note the system closes at 4:30 PM the day before, so book ahead of time.

Also, since the refresher is booked as the mini course, you'll need to complete the medical form: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-curso-en-espanol

Would you like me to help you sort out the referral course dates too, so everything lines up with April 5 and 6? 🐠

msg: Anything needs to be completed beforehand? I’m gonna need a little refresher.
reply:
Perfect — a refresher is a great way to get back in the water feeling confident. 🌊 It's the same activity as our Dive Mini Course, and it's designed exactly for certified divers who haven't dived in a while.

Here's what needs to be completed beforehand:

📝 *Forms*
• *Medical form* (required for the refresher, even if you're certified): https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-curso-en-espanol
• *Insurance form* — we send it to you in the booking confirmation email
• *Liability waiver* — the team sends it to you to fill in

📚 *Theory*
After booking you'll receive an email with the theory part. You must complete it *before* the practical session.

🤿 *On the day*
Pool session (theory review + practice) and 1 ocean dive with a PADI instructor.

⏱️ *After diving*
Wait at least *12 hours* before flying.

One thing to keep in mind: the refresher is normally required if it's been more than 2 years since your last dive. Very experienced divers (500+ dives or Dive Master) are reviewed by a team advisor.
